description: Removes a currently assigned member from a Trello card, affecting only the card's member list and not the member's board membership or overall permissions.

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card from which the member will be removed.
idCard.title: Id Card

idMember.description: The ID of the member to be unassigned from the card.
idMember.title: Id Member

name: remove_member_from_card

RemoveMemberFromCardResponse.description:
Response schema for `RemoveMemberFromCard`

Empty response body. This DELETE endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK status code with an
empty or null response body upon successful removal of a member from a card.
The 200 status code itself confirms successful operation.
RemoveMemberFromCardResponse.title: RemoveMemberFromCardResponse
